title: Horchata
description: Rice and cinnamon soaked overnight, blended, and strained into a cool, milky, lightly sweet agua fresca.
notes: Keeps three days in the fridge. Stir before pouring; it settles.

steps.text: Rinse the rice, then soak it with the cinnamon and almonds in 1 L of the water overnight.
Blend the rice, cinnamon, almonds, and soaking water until the rice is as fine as possible.
Strain through a fine sieve lined with muslin, squeezing out every drop.
steps.tip: Strain twice if you want it silky. Gritty horchata is the usual complaint.

steps.text: Stir in the remaining water, the sugar, milk, and vanilla until dissolved. Serve over ice.
